name: Studio Portrait
tagline: Editorial studio portraits with real photographic lighting.
description: A full studio session without booking a photographer: seamless paper backdrops, colored gels, beauty dishes, hard and soft light setups, and editorial poses. Great for personal branding, press kits, social profiles and portfolio covers.
negativePrompt: cartoon, anime, illustration, 3d render, painting, plastic skin, deformed face, distorted features, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, text, watermark, logo, nudity
